# Built to finish the job,   not just answer.

## Solar Open 2 & Solar Pro 4

Solar Pro 4 is our flagship agent model. Solar Open 2 is the open-weight one you run yourself. Pick the one that fits your workload.

Available now · Open weight

### Solar Open 2

A 250B mixture-of-experts model that activates only 15B parameters per token. Strong reasoning you can download and run on your own hardware.

Params250B

Context1M

ServingSelf-host

[Technical report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20062) [Get the weights](https://huggingface.co/upstage/Solar-Open2-250B)

AVAILABLE NOW · Production API

### Solar Pro 4

Built for agents. It searches, uses tools, checks results, and finishes the task. Not one good answer, but many steps carried through to the finish.

- Agent runs that finish, instead of stalling mid-chain
- Consistent across repeated runs: reliability, not a lucky pass.
- Real _work_ context: documents, finance, legal, medical
- Stops when there's no basis: no made-up answers.
- Priced per finished task: $0.30 in / $1.20 out per 1M.

[Try the demo](https://solar-chat.upstage.ai/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=offical&utm_campaign=sp4-launch-202608&utm_term=try_the_demo&utm_content=feature-cta) [Talk to us](https://www.upstage.ai/solar-llms#partner)

Terminal task completion, multi-turn tool use, long-document reasoning. A real step up in getting work done.
